# IEU-C2DataBase
# To further enhance the diversity of C2 channels, this dataset was generated by setting up an experimental environment for data collection. It includes communication traffic from 64 trojans (e.g. DarkComet, Sliver), captures of 8 types of WebShell interactions (e.g. Behinder, Godzilla), recorded attack traffic from 6 penetration frameworks (e.g. Metasploit, Cobalt Strike, Empire), and 54 RCE (Remote Code Execution) vulnerability exploitation behaviors (e.g., CVE-2023-27836), with a total volume of 1.82 GB. This dataset contains 1,530 valid C2 sessions, covering various protocols such as TCP, HTTP(S), ICMP, and DNS. Note: Only show the interaction-state transition sequence of C2 channel.
